name: Mateo Valencia
bio:
Mateo's passion for motorsport ignited early, fueled by watching Formula 1 races with his grandfather. He pursued vocational training in automotive painting and quickly specialized in custom finishes, drawn to the precision and artistry involved. His dedication landed him an apprenticeship with a restoration shop specializing in classic racing cars before Brad Jones Racing headhunted him. 

At BJR, Mateo meticulously manages the paint application process, ensuring perfect color matching, aerodynamic smoothness, and durable finishes that withstand the rigors of racing. He's known for his relentless pursuit of perfection and his ability to troubleshoot complex paint issues. Mateo's unique talent lies in his ability to visualize paint finishes in different lighting conditions, ensuring the cars look stunning both on the track and under the studio lights.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight wave
physical.description: Mateo is of average height with a wiry build, honed from hours of meticulous detail work.

quirks: Insists on using only high-quality imported Italian masking tape.
Always wears noise-canceling headphones while working, even when no machinery is running.
Has a collection of vintage racing posters displayed in his workstation.
